primary.notes: One maximum-score synthetic one-worker trajectory, not a recovered identity. 7s room windows, 20 rooms per sweep, arbitrary start phase, distinct channel changes with modeled gaps 2–12s, same nominal room times whether alert present or not. Reward 1 per room-window with >=1 consolidated observation, small gap penalty .035/sec over2s. Screenshot download time proxy. No credit for multiple alerts in a room. Missing marks do not distinguish empty room from no profitable deal. Whole hour retrospective optimization, not predictive validation.
